advisory.finding: The short-circuit now passes det_advisories into the BLOCK verdict (workflow_ops.py:221) — a NEW behavior for P1/P5 blocks, which previously ran the LLM and never took this path. No test asserts DET advisories reach the verdict's surfaced bucket in the short-circuit case; the completeness test (test_short_circuit_verdict_carries_every_det_blocking_finding) only checks the `blocking` bucket. A regression that dropped the det_advisories argument from the partition_findings call would go undetected.
merged_from: test_short_circuit_verdict_carries_every_det_blocking_finding derives its expected finding-id set by re-executing partition_findings with arguments identical to the production call (test lines 66-71 duplicate workflow_ops.py:220-222), so the oracle is coupled to the SUT's own helper — a bug inside partition_findings/mint_finding_id would appear on both sides and escape detection.
